name: Incel Syndrome
source:
The abstract male is the image of God, the absolute some-thing.

Sam isn't exactly looking for a girlfriend. He's content playing video games in his room and hanging out with his loser buddies Jake and Jonathan. Recently however, Sam has become entangled in a web of twisted theories, causing violent thoughts about the opposite sex to occupy his mind. Follow Sam during his irreversible descent into the abyss.

[From [url=https://www.socah.org/incelsyndrome/]official website[/url]]
